warnings: product-pr-2326: sigpipe-fragile: an unbounded producer (gh pr diff) is piped straight into `grep -q`, which exits at the first match and closes the pipe. The producer is then killed by SIGPIPE (exit 141) and, under the dod_verify runner's `bash -o pipefail`, 141 becomes the pipeline's exit status -- a false RED on evidence that is actually present (the same command exits 0 when run by hand outside pipefail). Buffer the producer instead, and assert against the buffered variable with a HERE-STRING, not a pipe -- `printf | grep -qF` is itself SIGPIPE-fragile once the variable is large (OMN-16916): body="$(<producer>)" && grep -qF 'MARKER' <<< "$body" (OMN-15411 Rule E)

    source: "generated"
    checks:

  - id: "dod-OmniNode-ai-omnimarket-pr-1927-deploy"
    description: "PR #1927 compute-only deploy proof: changed companion compute handler is readable at
      product head and carries the yamlfmt width fix."
    source: "manual"
    checks:
      - check_type: "command"
        check_value: "gh api repos/OmniNode-ai/omnimarket/contents/src/omnimarket/nodes/node_occ_companion_compute/handlers/handler_occ_companion_compute.py?ref=ad56a5adef22494e8aedd06921674500982e522b
          --jq .content | base64 -d | grep '_OCC_YAMLFMT_MAX_LINE_LENGTH = 100'"
  - id: "dod-14714-merged-0747500e-block-scalar-dumper"
    evidence_artifact: "supersedes_dod_evidence:dod-OmniNode-ai-omnimarket-pr-1927"
    description: >-
      Binds the load-bearing half of OMN-14714 — the `_BlockScalarDumper` that renders multi-line strings
      as literal `|` blocks so yamlfmt cannot delete the lone closing quote of a trailing-newline single-quoted
      scalar. Reads omnimarket content at the DURABLE squash commit 0747500e682c903301bc1bd9eb56578c6dad72af
      on `dev` (PR #1927, merged 2026-07-28T06:19:19Z), not a branch name and not the unmerged head SHA.
      Verified by execution 2026-07-28: exit 0 at 0747500e, exit 1 at its parent 848d3333553b5838d9ad1635be89e9d89f0f850b.
      Supersedes dod-OmniNode-ai-omnimarket-pr-1927, whose only check was `gh pr view --json number,state`
      — true of any PR that exists in any state with any diff, and classified non-falsifiable by validate_pr_deploy_required.classify_check_value.
    source: "manual"
    status: "verified"
    checks:
      - check_type: "command"
        check_value: |-
          gh api "repos/OmniNode-ai/omnimarket/contents/src/omnimarket/nodes/node_occ_companion_compute/handlers/handler_occ_companion_compute.py?ref=0747500e682c903301bc1bd9eb56578c6dad72af" --jq .content | base64 -d | grep -q 'class _BlockScalarDumper(yaml.SafeDumper):'
  - id: "dod-14714-merged-0747500e-width-matches-formatter"
    evidence_artifact: "supersedes_dod_evidence:dod-OmniNode-ai-omnimarket-pr-1927-deploy"
    description: >-
      Binds the second coupled cause — PyYAML's dump `width` now resolves to the `_OCC_YAMLFMT_MAX_LINE_LENGTH`
      constant that mirrors onex_change_control/.yamlfmt `formatter.max_line_length`. Verified by execution
      2026-07-28: exit 0 at 0747500e, exit 1 at parent 848d3333. Supersedes dod-OmniNode-ai-omnimarket-pr-1927-deploy,
      which was falsifiable in form but pinned `ref=ad56a5adef22494e8aedd06921674500982e522b` — the unmerged
      feature-branch head of PR #1927. A branch head is not a durable ref: it is reachable only until
      the branch is deleted or force-pushed, after which the probe errors rather than going honestly RED.
      The superseded entry is preserved for audit and not re-executed.
    source: "manual"
    status: "verified"
    checks:
      - check_type: "command"
        check_value: |-
          gh api "repos/OmniNode-ai/omnimarket/contents/src/omnimarket/nodes/node_occ_companion_compute/handlers/handler_occ_companion_compute.py?ref=0747500e682c903301bc1bd9eb56578c6dad72af" --jq .content | base64 -d | grep -q 'width=_OCC_YAMLFMT_MAX_LINE_LENGTH'
  - id: "dod-14714-merged-0747500e-stale-width-removed"
    evidence_artifact: "supersedes_dod_evidence:dod-OmniNode-ai-omnimarket-pr-1927-ci"
    description: >-
      Negative probe: the corrupting `width=1_000_000,` argument is gone from the dump site. Anchored
      to the code form (leading indentation, trailing comma) on purpose — an unanchored `width=1_000_000`
      still matches at 0747500e because the new comment block quotes the old value while explaining why
      it was wrong, so the naive absence check can never go GREEN. Caught by execution, not review. Verified
      2026-07-28: exit 0 at 0747500e, exit 1 at parent 848d3333. Supersedes dod-OmniNode-ai-omnimarket-pr-1927-ci
      (`gh pr view --json files`), which asserts a diff exists but nothing about its content.
    source: "manual"
    status: "verified"
    checks:
      - check_type: "command"
        check_value: |-
          ! gh api "repos/OmniNode-ai/omnimarket/contents/src/omnimarket/nodes/node_occ_companion_compute/handlers/handler_occ_companion_compute.py?ref=0747500e682c903301bc1bd9eb56578c6dad72af" --jq .content | base64 -d | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]+width=1_000_000,$'
  - id: "dod-14714-merged-0747500e-xfail-flipped"
    evidence_artifact: "supersedes_dod_evidence:occ-self-bind-pr-5260"
    description: >-
      Retires occ-self-bind-pr-5260 (a ${PR_NUMBER}/${REPO} PR-existence probe) from a product-bound entry
      on purpose. No replacement self-bind entry is minted: any check that reads this PR's own contract
      or diff matches OCC's `_is_inert_check` and the deploy-gate's SELF_REFERENTIAL_PATTERNS (`contracts/OMN-\d+\.ya?ml`),
      so a "falsifiable self-bind" is a contradiction — minting one would add exactly the class of evidence
      this repair exists to remove. Verified: the obvious candidate (`gh api .../pulls/5272/files --jq
      .patch | grep ...`) classifies INERT. Binds the acceptance half. The pre-existing guard `test_merged_path_supersession_is_yamlfmt_clean`
      carried `@pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True)` naming OMN-14714, so landing the fix mechanically forced
      the marker's removal. This probe asserts zero `pytest.mark.xfail` occurrences remain in that test
      module — an absence check is the only honest form for a removal. Verified by execution 2026-07-28:
      exit 0 at 0747500e (0 occurrences), exit 1 at parent 848d3333 (marker present at line 454, reason
      text at 456).
    source: "manual"
    status: "verified"
    checks:
      - check_type: "command"
        check_value: |-
          ! gh api "repos/OmniNode-ai/omnimarket/contents/tests/unit/nodes/node_occ_companion_compute/test_occ_emitter_golden_fixtures_omn_14710.py?ref=0747500e682c903301bc1bd9eb56578c6dad72af" --jq .content | base64 -d | grep -q 'pytest.mark.xfail'
  - id: "dod-14714-merged-0747500e-corruption-pinning-test"
    description: >-
      Binds the net-new regression test that pins the corruption mechanism specifically — yamlfmt's output
      over a merged-path supersession file must still parse AND be semantically identical, and the fixture
      must actually carry a multi-line scalar so the test cannot pass vacuously. Verified by execution
      2026-07-28: exit 0 at 0747500e, exit 1 at parent 848d3333. Honest scope limit: this proves the test
      exists in the merged tree at a durable ref; that it PASSES is proven by the omnimarket CI run on
      #1927, not by this check.
    source: "manual"
    status: "verified"
    checks:
      - check_type: "command"
        check_value: |-
          gh api "repos/OmniNode-ai/omnimarket/contents/tests/unit/nodes/node_occ_companion_compute/test_occ_emitter_golden_fixtures_omn_14710.py?ref=0747500e682c903301bc1bd9eb56578c6dad72af" --jq .content | base64 -d | grep -q 'def test_yamlfmt_does_not_corrupt_supersession_multiline_scalars'
  - id: "dod-14714-failclosed-stale-width-removed"
    evidence_artifact: "supersedes_dod_evidence:dod-14714-merged-0747500e-stale-width-removed"
    description: >-
      FAIL-CLOSED replacement for dod-14714-merged-0747500e-stale-width-removed, which FAILED OPEN. The
      superseded form was `! <gh api ...> | base64 -d | grep -qE ...`; `!` negates the PIPELINE exit status,
      i.e. grep's. When `gh api` produces no output — deleted/GC'd ref, API outage, rate limit, auth failure
      — grep exits 1 and `!` inverts it to exit 0, so the probe reports PASS while observing nothing.
      Demonstrated by execution 2026-07-28 against ref deadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeef: the superseded
      form exits 0 (vacuous PASS); this form exits 1. Nothing upstream catches it — validate_pr_deploy_required._command_of
      skips a leading `!` when finding command position, so the fail-open form still classifies falsifiable.
      The repair captures content to a variable and asserts it non-empty BEFORE negating the grep, so
      an unreadable ref goes RED instead of GREEN. Same assertion as before otherwise: the corrupting
      `width=1_000_000,` argument is absent from the dump site at the durable squash commit 0747500e682c903301bc1bd9eb56578c6dad72af,
      anchored to the code form because the new explanatory comment quotes the old value verbatim. Verified
      by execution 2026-07-28: exit 0 at 0747500e, exit 1 at parent 848d3333553b5838d9ad1635be89e9d89f0f850b,
      exit 1 at a nonexistent ref.
    source: "manual"
    status: "verified"
    checks:
      - check_type: "command"
        check_value: |-
          out=$(gh api "repos/OmniNode-ai/omnimarket/contents/src/omnimarket/nodes/node_occ_companion_compute/handlers/handler_occ_companion_compute.py?ref=0747500e682c903301bc1bd9eb56578c6dad72af" --jq .content | base64 -d) && test -n "$out" && ! printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]+width=1_000_000,$'
  - id: "dod-14714-failclosed-xfail-flipped"
    evidence_artifact: "supersedes_dod_evidence:dod-14714-merged-0747500e-xfail-flipped"
    description: >-
      FAIL-CLOSED, scope-narrowed replacement for dod-14714-merged-0747500e-xfail-flipped, which had two
      defects. (1) FAIL-OPEN: same `!`-negated-pipeline shape as above — verified 2026-07-28 to exit 0
      against a nonexistent ref; this form exits 1. (2) BRITTLE: it asserted zero `pytest.mark.xfail`
      occurrences anywhere in the module, so any future unrelated xfail added to that file would flip
      OMN-14714's evidence RED for reasons unrelated to OMN-14714. Simulated by execution on a copy of
      the merged file with one unrelated xfail inserted 40 lines above the target test: superseded form
      exits 1 (false RED), this form exits 0. The repair windows the absence assertion to the six lines
      directly above `def test_merged_path_supersession_is_yamlfmt_clean` — where the strict xfail actually
      sat at parent 848d3333 (lines 454-459) — and first asserts that the test function itself is still

  `sh -c` has no `pipefail` and `sha256sum` always exits 0 regardless of what its stdin contained. A sixth

  precedent''s supersedes_dod_evidence idiom) AND ships the authoring-time lint mechanism in the same
  PR: two new rules in scripts/lint_contract_check_values.py -- (Rule A) executable-command-shape, rejecting
  any check_value that does not open with a recognized command head or shell control keyword after stripping
  simple literal env-assignment prefixes; and (Rule B) per-item PR binding, rejecting a dod_evidence id
  that embeds a PR number (pr-(\d+)) when none of its gh pr view/checks/diff check_values literally references
  that number. A corpus-wide survey found the class-3 mis-binding defect alone is NOT unique to OMN-14968

The producer is then killed by SIGPIPE (exit 141) and, under the dod_verify runner's `bash -o pipefail`, 141 becomes the pipeline's exit status -- a false RED on evidence that is actually present (the same command exits 0 when run by hand outside pipefail). Buffer the producer instead, and assert against the buffered variable with a HERE-STRING, not a pipe -- `printf | grep -qF` is itself SIGPIPE-fragile once the variable is large (OMN-16916): body="$(<producer>)" && grep -qF 'MARKER' <<< "$body" (OMN-15411 Rule E)
